SW – 3 yr Lic. GeM: Yes
Compliant

  • Credentialed & non-credentialed scanning

Source Code Analyser (Cloud / SAST)

SW – 3 yr Lic. GeM: Yes
Compliant

Requirement

  • Secret Scanning, SAST, Malware Detection, Taint Tracking, Cross-Site Scripting
  • Buffer Overflow, Path Traversal, OS Commanding, Improper Input Handling
  • Languages: C++, C#, Java, Android, JS, ASP.Net, GA, Python, PHP, Objective C, Node.js,
  • C#, Angular.JS, VB.Net, Kotlin, Perl, Ruby, Go, Swift
  • Frameworks: .NET, Spring, Angular, React, EJB, JSF, Jest, Mocha, Jestl, Jersey, etc.
  • IDEs: Eclipse, Visual Studio, Visual Studio Code, Android Studio, eStudio
  • Hardware support: x86, ARM, ARM64, etc.
  • Deployment: On-premises; offline use; no internet access needed
  • Training: 30 scientists/year (Regular Technical Support & Rule/Patch Updates)
  • PoC (Proof of Concept) required
  • System Req: deployable on sub/server or laptop/desktop, no cloud resources needed
  • ML capabilities to auto fine-tune false positives/negatives

AccuKnox response

AccuKnox provides SAST, Secret Scanning, and detection of vulnerabilities such as XSS, Buffer Overflow, Path Traversal, and Command Injection. The solution supports a broad range of languages, frameworks, IDEs, and hardware architectures, and can be deployed fully on-premises, including air-gapped environments and leverages AI/ML-assisted capabilities to improve detection accuracy and reduce false positives.

Ref: https://help.accuknox.com/integrations/github-overview/

3

Source Code Analyser (On-premises)

SW – 3 yr Lic. GeM: Yes
Compliant

Requirement

  • Languages: C, C++, C#, Java (Kotlin), Python, JavaScript
  • Frameworks: .NET, Spring, Android, React, and major frameworks
  • Platform: Windows 10/11 (RHEL, Ubuntu, Debian, SUSE, Fedora)
  • Compiler: Must support embedded and enterprise compilers incl. Renesas, ARM CC,
  • Clang, GCC, Iodent, w32-gcc, x32-g++
  • Perpetual global license; unlimited scans; no project size or LOC limits
  • Analysis: on-the-fly selection, differential analysis, incremental analysis
  • Reporting: PDF, Excel, XML, CSV, customisable and pre-defined templates
  • Integration: for more, Cmake, Ninjas, makes, gradle, ant, Bazel, Sfonk, Ninjas
  • Integration support for more, Cmake, Ninjas, makes, gradle, ant, Bazel, Sfonk Ninjas
  • Support OEM with documentation (at least minimum 3 years)

AccuKnox response

AccuKnox enables comprehensive security scanning across on-premises environments. It supports code scanning for self-hosted CI/CD platforms, such as GitLab, and provides vulnerability and malware detection for both Linux-based (Ubuntu, RHEL, etc.) and Windows-based virtual machines, helping organizations strengthen their security posture across development and infrastructure assets.

The scanning engine supports all major programming languages, including C, C#, C++, Java, Kotlin, Python, and JavaScript, as well as popular frameworks such as Spring Boot, .NET, and React. Beyond identifying security issues, AccuKnox provides detailed remediation guidance, comprehensive reports, and end-to-end findings lifecycle management to streamline vulnerability remediation and compliance workflows.

Support for incremental scanning and Android application scanning is currently on the product roadmap.

Nessus VA Tool

SW – 3 yr Lic. GeM: Yes
Compliant

Requirement

  • Network vulnerability scanning
  • Reference to CVE, non-standard guides and best practices
  • Ability to generate reports in PDF, Word, CSV formats

AccuKnox response

AccuKnox supports integration with Nessus for host endpoint vulnerability scanning and CVE analysis. The findings are displayed within the AccuKnox UI, providing centralized visibility and management. In addition, AccuKnox offers automated workflows, findings lifecycle management, and PDF-based vulnerability assessment (VA) reports for Nessus. Findings can also be exported in CSV format for further analysis and reporting.

Compiler Code / Firmware Analysis

SW – 3 yr Lic. GeM: YES
Partially compliant

Requirement

  • Architectures: x86, x86-64, ARM, ARM64, MIPS, PowerPC, RISC-V
  • Binary Formats: PE, ELF, Mach-O, raw binaries; firmware images shared
  • Disassembly Capability Required
  • Decompilation: High-level pseudocode (C-like or equivalent)
  • Static Binary Analysis (function detection, cross-reference, symbol analysis)
  • Binary Diffing (comparison of two binaries or firmware versions)
  • Symbolic Execution (support for malicious behavior patterns, indicators)
  • Vulnerability Correlation: CVERVD, CISA KEV
  • Hardcoded Secrets Detection (credentials, API keys, certificates in firmware)
  • Cryptographic Analysis (crypto keys and certificates)
  • Regular updates; Vendor Verify(OEM) mandatory

AccuKnox response

AccuKnox provides SAST capabilities for source code and build artifacts, including vulnerability detection, hardcoded secret identification, cryptographic analysis, and correlation with CVE and CISA KEV databases. The platform includes regular updates and enterprise support. Advanced reverse-engineering capabilities such as binary decompilation, symbolic execution, and firmware analysis are in roadmap.

SBoM Analysis Tool

SW – 3 yr Lic. GeM: Yes
Compliant

Requirement

  • Scans 500 or higher
  • On-premises deployment; SBOM Standards: SPDX, CycloneDX
  • SBOM Generation from binaries, source code, firmware images
  • Report export in popular formats
  • Component Enumeration: 3rd-party, open-source, embedded; external libraries
  • Vulnerability Correlation: CVERVD, CISA KEV
  • Hardcoded Secrets Detection (credentials, API keys, certificates in firmware)
  • Cryptographic Analysis (crypto keys, certificates in firmware)
  • Regular updates; 24x7 Online/Onsite support; License minimum 1 year

AccuKnox response

AccuKnox supports large-scale SBOM generation and analysis with support for SPDX and CycloneDX standards. The solution can generate SBOMs from source code, binaries, and firmware images, enumerate open-source, third-party, embedded, and external library components, and correlate vulnerabilities with CVE/NVD and CISA KEV databases. It also provides hardcoded secret detection, cryptographic artifact analysis, exportable reports in common formats, regular updates, and enterprise support.
